claim: An Aurora global database can use a mixed configuration of provisioned or serverless instance class types between the primary and secondary Regions.
question: Can an Aurora global database mix provisioned and serverless instances between Regions?

values.display: mixed configuration of provisioned or serverless instance class types

evidence.quote: You can use a mixed configuration of provisioned or serverless instance class types between your primary and secondary Regions.

claim: In an Aurora global database you can configure the primary Region as the Aurora I/O-Optimized cluster configuration and the secondary Regions as Aurora Standard, or the reverse.
question: Can the primary and secondary Regions of an Aurora global database use different storage configurations?

values.display: primary Region as the Aurora I/O-Optimized cluster configuration and your secondary Regions as Aurora Standard or the reverse

evidence.quote: You can also configure your primary Region as the Aurora I/O-Optimized cluster configuration and your secondary Regions as Aurora Standard or the reverse.
